input.subject: Laptop will not boot
input.description: Laptop shows a black screen on power up and does not respond to any key presses.

notes: Blocked with 'That answer isn't correct.' A follow-up regression check (via direct DOM inspection, not just the accessibility snapshot) confirmed the security question and answer field do regenerate/clear after a failed attempt as designed; an initial scoped-snapshot read during testing looked stale and was a test-tooling artifact, not a site bug.
Staff ID error: 'Staff ID must be exactly 6 digits.' Email error: 'Email must be a valid @uobgroup.com address.'
